title: After photo is a stock doorstep image
description: Deliver a parcel to a front door; the worker uploads a known stock photo of a parcel on a doorstep instead.

criteria.label: Parcel visible at the delivery door
Parcel undamaged and not exposed to weather

notes: MANUAL §9.5 "stock parcel image". after_1.jpg MUST be a copy of an image in eval/stock/ (currently cp eval/stock/placeholder-doorstep-1.jpg). Forensics hashes eval/stock/* on every run, so EXACT_DUPLICATE (HIGH) -> HUMAN_REVIEW. Keep the committed placeholder until real stock photos replace it.
